verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Volibear's Q stun before level 6; you win once Realm of Death comes online and isolates him from help.

brief.thesis: Volibear's all-in is front-loaded on Thundering Smash (Q) landing a stun, while Mordekaiser's entire kit — Death's Grasp (E) pull into Obliterate (Q), and Indestructible (W) banking damage into a shield — needs forced extended trades to pay off. That mismatch is exactly why OP.GG's own read is to avoid fights before 6 and farm: Mordekaiser has no stun immunity or burst answer to Q pre-6, but Realm of Death (R) flips the entire structure by yanking Volibear away from his jungler and making it a duel on Mordekaiser's terms.

theirWindow.what: He dashes to the first champion he attacks and stuns on hit. Don't stand in a straight line he can dash through, and don't contest a trade right after he's reset the cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s).

yourWindow.what: Drag him with R the moment he overextends for CS or a ward — it steals a portion of his stats and removes him from his jungler's reach, then chain E (Death's Grasp) to pull him back in range of Q (Obliterate), which hits hardest on a single target.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 63.1% pick rate at 50.9% WR over 214 games — the mana sustain lets you throw Obliterate (Q) on cooldown while farming through the levels 3-5 window instead of trading.

boots.why: 51.7% pick rate at 48.2% WR — the magic resist blunts Volibear's passive bonus magic damage on-hit, and the tenacity shortens how long Thundering Smash's stun locks you down.

core.why: Slow from Q/E keeps a melee dasher like Volibear inside your Death's Grasp (E) range instead of resetting with his own gap close.
Omnivamp sustains you through his W (Frenzied Maul) poke and lets Indestructible (W) bank even more off prolonged trades.
Burn stacks punish him for standing in Obliterate (Q) and Death's Grasp (E) range during extended skirmishes.

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are how Mordekaiser wins this matchup once R is up, and the healing scaling rewards staying in the fight rather than poking and resetting.

summoners.why: 84.2% pick rate at 50.4% WR — Ignite punishes his W self-heal reapplication and secures kills once R isolates him post-6.

playing.title: Farm, don't fight before 6
playing.detail: OP.GG's own data backs this: your win condition starts at R, not before. Use Obliterate (Q) only on waves/jungle camps through levels 1-5.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Thundering Smash is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — if he just whiffed it or used it on a minion, that's your window to step up and farm aggressively.

playing.title: Bank Indestructible passively
playing.detail: W's shield builds from damage dealt AND taken, so poking him with Q chip even in neutral exchanges stacks your shield for free.

playing.title: Isolate with R at every overextension
playing.detail: The instant he pushes for CS or vision past mid-lane at level 6+, drag him with Realm of Death before his jungler can help.

playing.title: Chain E into Q after the pull
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls him into point-blank range, and Obliterate hits hardest on a single target — always land E first in any trade.

playing.title: Respect Sky Splitter's range
playing.detail: His E is a 1200-range skillshot that slows and shields him if he's caught in the blast — don't give him a static target to land it on while you're farming.

playing.title: Build Rylai's first for the slow
playing.detail: Keeping him chilled from Q/E denies his dash-reset pattern and is the single biggest lane-phase swing in your build order.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why each timing and item choice matters — is my own read of the kit interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Volibear before reaching level 6. Use your skills to focus on farming and contesting lane.
